title: Delete needs confirmation dialog plus Recycle Bin integration for recovery
context: Destructive menu item teaches people the menu is where you manage files. Bare Delete is worse than no Delete at all.
decision: Delete requires confirmation dialog (counts folder contents, names unsaved work, focuses Cancel). Deletion goes through trash crate, making it recoverable via OS Recycle Bin.
consequences: Delete can appear in the menu because the two barriers (confirmation + recovery) are in place. Unconfirmed destructive action never happens on a single click.
